why: Reached from a glacier landing and climbs steep snow with crevasses on the way, on the Mount Logan massif.
The ridge rises from the big glaciers of the Logan massif and is approached across crevassed glacier.
Its own text calls for standard glacier-travel equipment.
The approach says to cross a short glacier to reach the climb.
A bergschrund and a 60 degree snow couloir with a cornice are stated, but a search could not confirm the glacier below.
No text, and a search found nothing on this peak, so neither fact could be checked.
